title: Security review of JSON serialization for credential fields
description: Conduct a security review to ensure database credentials are never included in JSON serialization, addressing PRD requirement F7 and US-2.3.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON serialization code paths are reviewed for credential fields
No host, port, database, user, or password fields appear in JSON output

evidence: Security review document: reports/security/TASK-033-credential-security-review.md

Code review of src/serialization/diagramSerializer.ts: verified CREDENTIAL_FIELDS Set (host, port, database, user, password), stripCredentials() recursive guard (case-insensitive, non-mutating, array/object traversal), applied as defense-in-depth final step in serializeDiagram()
Code review of src/schema/diagram.schema.json: verified additionalProperties: false at root and all $defs levels (Diagram, Table, Column, Relationship, UniqueConstraint, Index)
Code review of src/components/ExportButton.tsx: verified calls serializeDiagram() directly with no credential augmentation; no credential field references in component
Code review of backend/src/routes/test-connection.ts and read-schema.ts: verified JSON responses contain only success/failure status and schema metadata; credentials never in response bodies
Code review of src/hooks/useConnection.ts: verified credentials held in React state only, never persisted to localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/cookies, cleared on disconnect and session end
Code review of src/types/diagram.ts: verified Diagram type has no credential fields (host, port, database, user, password)

Semgrep SAST: .semgrep/credential-in-export.yaml with 2 rules (no-credentials-in-diagram-serialization, no-credentials-in-export-button); 0 findings on src/serialization/ (previously verified in STORY-011)
Gitleaks secret scan: 1 false positive only in git-ignored QA artifact; no real secrets in source code (previously verified in STORY-011)

Unit test evidence (prior containerized runs): diagramSerializer.test.ts 19/19 passed including credential-absence tests; ExportButton.test.tsx 5/5 passed including no-credentials download test; full suite 360 tests across 28 files passed (TASK-027), all 19 test suites passed (STORY-011)
All acceptance criteria met: (1) JSON serialization code paths reviewed, (2) no host/port/database/user/password in JSON output, (3) security review document produced
